contract.deliverable: Integrate the Acme payments API for refunds including retry and idempotency handling
acceptance: A refund is issued exactly once for a given idempotency key
A 5xx response from Acme is retried with backoff

managerSetup: open an FMECA session covering retries, duplicate refunds and key storage before implementation
expected.rationale: Money movement and idempotency failures are costly and hard to reverse, so failure modes get scored before code
